privileged_info_for_vlm: The survey title must be 'Framing Effect Experiment - Cognitive Decision Making Study 2024'. There must be exactly 5 groups. The randomization group name for Scenarios A, B, and C must be exactly 'experimental' (case-insensitive). Scenario A must mention 600 people, Scenario B 60 employees, and Scenario C 1200 homes. The survey must be activated.
